meanings.en: to move back or away from a position
meanings.exampleEn: The floodwaters slowly began to recede after the storm.
meanings.exampleTr: Fırtınadan sonra sel suları yavaşça çekilmeye başladı.

meanings.en: to become gradually weaker or smaller
meanings.exampleEn: His hopes of winning began to recede as the results came in.
meanings.exampleTr: Sonuçlar geldikçe kazanma umutları azalmaya başladı.

meanings.en: the desk where guests or visitors are welcomed in a hotel or office
meanings.exampleEn: Please leave your key at the reception desk when you check out.
meanings.exampleTr: Çıkış yaparken anahtarınızı resepsiyona bırakın.

meanings.en: willing to consider or accept new ideas or suggestions
meanings.exampleEn: The manager was receptive to our proposal for flexible working hours.
meanings.exampleTr: Müdür esnek çalışma saatleri önerimize açıktı.

meanings.en: to fill a battery with electrical power again
meanings.exampleEn: I need to recharge my phone before we leave.
meanings.exampleTr: Çıkmadan önce telefonumu şarj etmem gerekiyor.

meanings.en: to rest in order to regain energy
meanings.exampleEn: She took a week off to recharge after the busy project.
meanings.exampleTr: Yoğun projeden sonra enerji toplamak için bir hafta izin aldı.

meanings.en: involving two people or groups who give each other help or advantages
meanings.exampleEn: The two countries signed a reciprocal trade agreement.
meanings.exampleTr: İki ülke karşılıklı bir ticaret anlaşması imzaladı.

meanings.en: happening again and again
meanings.exampleEn: A recurring problem with the software caused repeated crashes.
meanings.exampleTr: Yazılımdaki tekrarlayan bir sorun sürekli çökmelere neden oldu.

meanings.en: to lower the level of quality that is expected or required
meanings.exampleEn: The company refused to reduce standards just to cut costs.
meanings.exampleTr: Şirket sadece maliyetleri düşürmek için standartları düşürmeyi reddetti.

meanings.en: to think carefully about something
meanings.exampleEn: She took some time to reflect on her career choices.
meanings.exampleTr: Kariyer seçimleri üzerine düşünmek için biraz zaman ayırdı.

meanings.en: to affect other people's opinion of someone or something
meanings.exampleEn: His rude behavior reflects on the whole team.
meanings.exampleTr: Onun kaba davranışı tüm ekibe kötü yansıyor.

meanings.en: to clean, decorate, and equip a building or object to make it look new again
meanings.exampleEn: They plan to refurbish the old hotel and reopen it next year.
meanings.exampleTr: Eski oteli yenileyip gelecek yıl yeniden açmayı planlıyorlar.

meanings.en: the process of cleaning and improving a building or object
meanings.exampleEn: The office is closed for refurbishment until next month.
meanings.exampleTr: Ofis gelecek aya kadar tadilat nedeniyle kapalı.

meanings.en: about or concerning a particular subject
meanings.exampleEn: I am writing regarding your recent application.
meanings.exampleTr: Son başvurunuzla ilgili olarak yazıyorum.

meanings.en: returning to a previous and less advanced state
meanings.exampleEn: Critics called the new policy a regressive step for education.
meanings.exampleTr: Eleştirmenler yeni politikayı eğitim için gerileyen bir adım olarak nitelendirdi.

meanings.tr: düşük gelirliyi daha çok vergilendiren (vergi için)
meanings.en: of a tax that takes a larger proportion from low-income earners
meanings.exampleEn: Sales tax is often criticized as being regressive.
meanings.exampleTr: Satış vergisi genellikle düşük gelirliyi daha çok etkileyen bir vergi olarak eleştirilir.

meanings.en: the quality of happening in a regular, predictable pattern
meanings.exampleEn: He visits his parents with great regularity every weekend.
meanings.exampleTr: Her hafta sonu ebeveynlerini büyük bir düzenlilikle ziyaret ediyor.

meanings.en: prepared and practiced carefully in advance, sometimes seeming unnatural
meanings.exampleEn: Her answer sounded too rehearsed to be sincere.
meanings.exampleTr: Cevabı samimi olamayacak kadar ezberlenmiş geliyordu.

meanings.en: a return to a worse state after an improvement
meanings.exampleEn: After months of recovery, he suffered a relapse.
meanings.exampleTr: Aylarca süren iyileşmenin ardından bir nüks yaşadı.

meanings.en: to return to a previous bad condition
meanings.exampleEn: She was afraid she might relapse into her old habits.
meanings.exampleTr: Eski alışkanlıklarına geri dönmekten korkuyordu.

meanings.tr: alt lige düşme, alt sıraya indirme
meanings.en: the act of moving something or someone to a lower position or rank
meanings.exampleEn: The team is fighting to avoid relegation this season.
meanings.exampleTr: Takım bu sezon alt lige düşmemek için mücadele ediyor.

meanings.en: in a continuous and determined way that does not stop
meanings.exampleEn: She worked relentlessly to finish the report on time.
meanings.exampleTr: Raporu zamanında bitirmek için durmaksızın çalıştı.

meanings.en: the quality of being trustworthy or performing consistently well
meanings.exampleEn: The car is known for its reliability and low maintenance costs.
meanings.exampleTr: Araba güvenilirliği ve düşük bakım maliyetiyle biliniyor.

meanings.en: in a way that can be trusted or depended on
meanings.exampleEn: The old machine still works reliably after many years.
meanings.exampleTr: Eski makine yıllar sonra hâlâ güvenilir bir şekilde çalışıyor.

meanings.en: to give up or let go of something, especially power or a possession
meanings.exampleEn: He was forced to relinquish control of the company.
meanings.exampleTr: Şirketin kontrolünü bırakmak zorunda kaldı.

meanings.en: the act of giving up something such as a right or possession
meanings.exampleEn: The agreement required the relinquishment of all claims to the land.
meanings.exampleTr: Anlaşma, araziye ilişkin tüm hak taleplerinden vazgeçilmesini gerektiriyordu.

meanings.en: to enjoy something greatly
meanings.exampleEn: She relishes the challenge of solving difficult problems.
meanings.exampleTr: Zor problemleri çözmenin verdiği zorluktan büyük keyif alıyor.

meanings.en: a spicy or sweet sauce eaten with food to add flavor
meanings.exampleEn: He added some relish to his hot dog.
meanings.exampleTr: Sosisli sandviçine biraz turşu sosu ekledi.

meanings.en: to depend on or trust someone or something
meanings.exampleEn: You can rely on her to finish the job well.
meanings.exampleTr: İşi iyi bitireceğine ona güvenebilirsin.

meanings.en: to make something again or in a new way
meanings.exampleEn: The studio decided to remake the classic film.
meanings.exampleTr: Stüdyo klasik filmi yeniden çekmeye karar verdi.

meanings.en: a new version of an old film or song
meanings.exampleEn: The remake was more successful than the original.
meanings.exampleTr: Yeni çekim orijinalinden daha başarılı oldu.

meanings.en: able to be corrected or cured
meanings.exampleEn: Fortunately, the fault in the system was easily remediable.
meanings.exampleTr: Neyse ki sistemdeki hata kolayca düzeltilebilirdi.

meanings.en: making you think of something else because of similar qualities
meanings.exampleEn: The music was reminiscent of the 1980s.
meanings.exampleTr: Müzik 1980'leri anımsatıyordu.

meanings.en: careless or failing to do what you should do
meanings.exampleEn: It would be remiss of me not to thank everyone for their help.
meanings.exampleTr: Herkese yardımları için teşekkür etmemek benim adıma kusur olurdu.

meanings.en: to change the structure or form of something, especially a building
meanings.exampleEn: They decided to remodel their kitchen this summer.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu yaz mutfaklarını yeniden düzenlemeye karar verdiler.

meanings.en: the process of changing the structure or appearance of a building
meanings.exampleEn: The remodeling of the bathroom took three weeks.
meanings.exampleTr: Banyonun tadilatı üç hafta sürdü.

meanings.en: feeling sorry and guilty for something bad you have done
meanings.exampleEn: He was deeply remorseful for the harm he had caused.
meanings.exampleTr: Sebep olduğu zarar için derinden pişmandı.

meanings.en: in a way that shows you feel sorry and guilty
meanings.exampleEn: She looked at him remorsefully and apologized.
meanings.exampleTr: Ona pişmanlıkla baktı ve özür diledi.

meanings.en: earning or bringing a good amount of money
meanings.exampleEn: He gave up teaching for a more remunerative career in finance.
meanings.exampleTr: Öğretmenliği bırakıp finans alanında daha kazançlı bir kariyere yöneldi.

meanings.en: to break a promise or fail to keep an agreement
meanings.exampleEn: The company reneged on its promise to raise wages.
meanings.exampleTr: Şirket ücretleri artırma sözünden caydı.

meanings.en: a person who pays money to use a house, car, or other property
meanings.exampleEn: As a renter, she was not responsible for major repairs.
meanings.exampleTr: Kiracı olarak büyük onarımlardan sorumlu değildi.

meanings.en: to open again after being closed
meanings.exampleEn: The restaurant will reopen after the renovations are complete.
meanings.exampleTr: Restoran tadilat tamamlandıktan sonra yeniden açılacak.

meanings.en: to start dealing with a matter or case again
meanings.exampleEn: Police decided to reopen the investigation.
meanings.exampleTr: Polis soruşturmayı yeniden açmaya karar verdi.

meanings.en: money paid by a country or group to compensate for damage or wrongdoing
meanings.exampleEn: The defeated nation was required to pay reparations.
meanings.exampleTr: Yenilen ülkeden tazminat ödemesi istendi.

meanings.en: quick, clever, and witty conversation or replies
meanings.exampleEn: The two comedians were famous for their sharp repartee.
meanings.exampleTr: İki komedyen keskin hazırcevaplıklarıyla ünlüydü.

meanings.en: the act of paying back money that was borrowed, or an amount paid
meanings.exampleEn: The monthly repayment on the loan is quite high.
meanings.exampleTr: Kredinin aylık geri ödemesi oldukça yüksek.

meanings.en: feeling strong dislike or disgust toward something
meanings.exampleEn: She was repelled by the smell of the rotten food.
meanings.exampleTr: Çürümüş yemeğin kokusundan tiksindi.

meanings.en: extremely unpleasant, causing disgust
meanings.exampleEn: His arrogant manner was utterly repellent.
meanings.exampleTr: Kibirli tavrı son derece iticiydi.

meanings.en: a substance that keeps insects or other things away
meanings.exampleEn: Don't forget to bring insect repellent for the hike.
meanings.exampleTr: Yürüyüş için böcek kovucu getirmeyi unutma.

meanings.tr: yeniden ifade etmek, başka kelimelerle söylemek
meanings.en: to say or write something again using different words
meanings.exampleEn: Could you rephrase the question in simpler terms?
meanings.exampleTr: Soruyu daha basit kelimelerle yeniden ifade edebilir misin?

meanings.tr: yeniden ifade etme, başka sözcüklerle anlatma
meanings.en: the act of expressing something again in different words
meanings.exampleEn: A careful rephrasing made the sentence much clearer.
meanings.exampleTr: Dikkatli bir yeniden ifade cümleyi çok daha anlaşılır kıldı.

meanings.en: able to be replaced by something or someone else
meanings.exampleEn: The worn parts are easily replaceable.
meanings.exampleTr: Yıpranmış parçalar kolayca değiştirilebilir.

meanings.en: to fill something up again or restore a supply
meanings.exampleEn: We need to replenish our stock of paper before the meeting.
meanings.exampleTr: Toplantıdan önce kağıt stokumuzu yeniden doldurmamız gerekiyor.

meanings.en: a state of rest, calm, or peaceful quietness
meanings.exampleEn: Her face was calm and full of repose as she slept.
meanings.exampleTr: Uyurken yüzü sakin ve huzur doluydu.
